name: ... Two in the Bag
description:
+100% Armorkit Capacity
+300% Grenade Capacity
+25% Ammo Capacity
+10% Repair-skills
+10% Status Effects

name: Combat Medic
description:
+80% Revive Speed
-50% Weakened Debuff timer
Provides +50% Damage Resistance to both agents while reviving or being revived, and for 10s after a successful revive.
Successful revives provide +1 Skill Tier for 5s. Revives at Skill Tier 6 grant Overcharge for 15s.

name: Kill Confirmed
description: Enemies you kill drop a trophy on death. Collecting trophies provides both a short and long term buff, the first of which scales with the number of core attributes equipped, and lasts 10s. - +5% Weapon Damage - +10% Bonus Armor - +5% Skill Efficiency For every trophy collected, gain an additional +1% weapon damage, +1% skill efficiency, and +0.1% armor regeneration for 300s. Maximum 30 stacks.

name: One in Hand...
description: Damaging an enemy with a grenade grants +100% skill tier for 15s.  Grants overcharge if already at skill tier 6.

name: Rebalance
description:
Getting kills and hitting enemies 300% times builds Red stacks. Each stack provides 0.5% Weapon Damage.

Getting hit 300% times builds Blue stacks. Each stack provides 0.5% Damage Resistance.

Upon reaching 80 stacks in total, lose all stacks and receive a separate bonus of 0.5% Damage Resistance per Red stack and 0.5% Weapon Damage per Blue stack until the next time the stack cap is reached.

name: Versatile
description: Slots in with any equipped Gear Set and or Brand Set item to fulfill a requirement towards unlocking a Gear Sets bonus. Can unlock bonuses from multiple sets simultaneously.

name: Ablative Nano-Plating
description:
Whenever your or any ally's armor breaks, they gain 80% of your armor as bonus armor for 10s.

Cooldown per ally: 45s

Killing an enemy with your specialization weapon removes this cooldown for all allies.

name: Bleeding Edge
description:
Shooting enemies within 15m applies bleed to the target.

Repair 3%-48% of your armor per second for every enemy that is bleeding within 15m.

Repair strength per number of bleeding enemies:

1:3% 2:6% 3:12% 4:24% 5:48%

name: Bond
description:
Both you and Allies receive +30% Critical Hit Damage, +15% Skill Efficiency and +2% Armor Regen when an Ally is within 10m of you.

Receive +15% Critical Hit Damage, +7.5% Skill Efficiency and +1% Armor Regen when one of your Skills is within 10m of you.

Only the highest group of buffs can be active at one time.

name: Challenger
description: Receive +25% Damage Resistence from enemies within 20m.

name: Charged Proxies
description:
Whenever you throw a skill, 125% seconds after landing, it creates an explosion applying the infused status effect to all enemies within 6m. 

Enemies affected by the infused status effect take 50% more damage from your skills.

name: Energy Infusion
description: Whenever you apply a status effect, your gloves become infused with that effect for 60s. While infused, you gain +10% skill damage, +10% skill healing and repair, and +10% skill duration for each you have. Applying the same status effect while infused does not refresh the infusion.

name: Iron Grip
description:
-50% Recoil Penalty when hip-firing.
-50% Recoil Penalty when blind-firing from cover.

name: Over the top
description:
Damaging an enemy with a grenade or striking an enemy with a melee attack activates Seeing Red

Seeing Red grants +25% weapon damage and +100% to melee damage. 

Seeing Red lasts 20 seconds and has a 60 second cooldown after completion.

While in cooldown, damaging  an enemy with a melee attack or hitting an enemy with the effect of a grenade will complete the cooldown instantly.

name: Smoke Screen
description:
On Armor break, drop a Smoke Bomb at your feet, concealing you from enemies for 300%s.
Cooldown: 40s

name: Transference Overclock
description: Detonating a Booster or Artificer Hive refreshes all allies' skill cooldowns and grants them overcharge for 15s. This can occur at most once per 120s.

name: Alternating Current
description: Generate a stack of 2.5% skill damage on one of your skills every second, capping at 10 stacks. After 10 seconds at the cap the stacks transfer to your other skill. The process then repeats ad-infinitum.

name: Bob and Weave
description:
Receive repairs of 5% of your Total Armor for every 1m run in cover-to-cover.
Damage taken while doing a cover-to-cover is healed over 10s.

name: Counter
description:
Swapping weapons will give the following groups of bonuses one by one, in order:

1. +20% Rate of Fire, +20% Weapon Damage
2. +50% Magazine Size, +50% Reload Speed

The bonuses remain active for 12s or until the next weapon swap.
Swapping to your sidearm will not trigger the next group of bonuses.

name: Defibrillator
description:
While "Shocker Punch" is equipped, the stun received by the agent from the Shock status effect will be reduced by 50%.

Using a shield will give 100% to melee damage.

Using St. Elmo's Engine with the holster will give 100% extra melee dmg and will make the next melee attack to apply Shock to the target.

Using all three items will offer all of the above mentioned bonuses and the Shock from the melee attack will have a 5m radius, starting from the first target.

15 seconds cooldown.

name: Dragon's Glare
description:
While in combat, applies burn to the enemy closet to you within 20m.

Cooldown: 35s

name: Perforator
description:
Shots fired from your pistol penetrate enemies.
 
Pistol headshot kills grant +20% weapon damage and allows your primary and secondary weapons to penetrate enemies for 8s.  This duration is increased to 11s when using a revolver.

name: Quick Draw
description:
While your pistol is holstered, gain a stacking buff every 30%s, up to 100.

When you swap to it, your first shot consumes the buff and deals +10% damage per stack.

name: Quick Draw
description:
+100% Weapon Swap Speed

Swapping to your pistol reloads all weapons.

name: Escape Plan
description:
Vaulting grants +10% Movement Speed for 300%s.
After not moving for 5s, receive +20% Movement Speed for 5s.
Being applied a Status Effect grants +10% Movement Speed for 5s.
Max Movement Speed bonus is 20%. The bonuses do not stack with Movement Speed bonuses from other sources.
-50% Movement Impairment penalty from Status Effects.

name: First Wave Tech
description: Disruption effects destroy hostile skill proxies.

name: Grace Under Fire
description:
Cannot be staggered by explosions.

Staying in cover without firing for 10-{3}s provides damage immunity while aiming for 3%-10s.

name: Impervious
description: Both you and Allies within 10m of you receive +40% Hazard Protection.

name: Lead by Example
description: While Cover Swapping all bullets that hit you are deflected towards their origin dealing no damage to you. Completing a cover to cover swap with this buff active consumes the buff giving the player Bonus Armor and releases a disruption effect, the amount of Bonus Armor and radius of the disruption is based off the distance traveled. Specialization weapons are not reflected by this buff.

name: Ostracize
description:
Shooting an enemy applies a mark. Only one mark can be active at a time. The mark disappears after 15s, or when the marked enemy dies.
Receive 6% Amplified Damage from the marked enemy.
Deal 20% Amplified Damage to unmarked enemies. 
If only one enemy remains in combat, the mark disappears and cannot be reapplied.

name: Parkour!
description: Performing a cover to cover or vaulting reloads your drawn weapon.

name: Abridged
description:
If your Primary and Secondary weapons are not Exotic or Named and of the same type, the Secondary Weapon's talent will also be applied to the Primary Weapon.
Does not apply to Talents that include weapon swapping,

name: Chemical Agent
description:
Catalysis
Dealing and receiving status effects (Burn, Bleed, Shock, EMP/Disrupt, Poison, and Blind/Disorient) builds stacks of Catalysis to a maximum of 12. Each stack grants:
    +2% weapon damage
    +2% status effects

Each enemy within 25 meters that is affected by a status effect grants +100% stack/sec. Being affected by status effects grants +200% stacks/sec.
Stacks decay at 100% stack/sec after 5s if no enemies in the radius or you are affected by status effects.

Reactant
At max stacks, killing a status-affected enemy grants bonuses for 5s:
    +25% bonus armor
    +20% reload speed

Stabilizer
While burning, you can maintain ADS without disruption.

name: Hephaestus’ Wrath
description:
Every hit of fire damage builds up stacks of Wrath up to 50. Each stack grants:
+0.5% Weapon Damage
+0.5% Skill Damage

Stacks persist as long as you remain in the fire source and 5s after.

While burning you maintain ability to aim down sights and your weapon handling is unaffected by the burn status effect.

Defeating an enemy while you are burning causes them to drop in a pool of Greek Fire and triggers:
- Repair of 20% of your missing armor.
- Refreshes the burn status effects of enemies already burning on a 10m radius.

name: Pack Instincts
description:
You and all allies gain a bonus based on the distance of the last enemy you hit.

0-15m: +25% critical hit damage
15-25m: +10% critical hit damage and +10% critical hit chance
25m+: +25% critical hit chance

name: Slotted
description:
Receive bonuses for each non-Core Attribute on this item, depending on their color:
Red: +10% Critical Hit Damage
Yellow: +5% Skill Efficiency
Blue: +1% Armor Regen

This item can feature any Core Attribute. This item features a third random Attribute instead of having a Gear Mod Slot.
This item cannot feature the Headshot Damage, Health or Skill Repair Attributes.

name: Toxic Delivery
description:
Status effects also apply a damage over time debuff for 10s.

Total damage dealt is equal to 50% of your concussion grenade damage and increased by your status effect attributes.

name: Vicious Cycle
description: Taking damage builds stacks to a cap of 30. Each stack grants 1.5% Weapon Damage. Taking damage at max stacks triggers a purge, removing all stacks and Status Effects and then dropping a healing cloud which restores 5% of Max Armor for 10s to all allies in the cloud.

name: Weakest Link
description:
Amplifies Weapon Damage by 30% to the lowest ranking enemies within the Tier hierarchy.

Tier 1: Hunter, Rogue, Leader, Tank, Shield, Heavy Weapons, RPG, Medic, Controller, Warhound, Marauder

Tier 2: Support, Engineer, Bodyguard, Immobilizer, Bomber, Mini Tank, Drone Operator

Tier 3: Any other enemy or skill proxy

name: ...but you can't touch
description:
100% stack is automatically consumed to fully repair one instance of damage you receive.
1 stack replenishes every 300%s.

name: Actum Est
description:
Shooting an enemy with this weapon will give 1 stack. 

At 100 stacks the next magazine will be filled with shock ammo.

name: Ardent
description:
Shooting heats the weapon up, filling the heat meter.  The meter is equivalent to 50% of the weapon's Magazine Size.

When the meter is full, rounds shot by the weapon ignite enemies.

When not shooting, the meter contantly depletes. Reloading or swapping the weapon fully depletes the meter.

name: Busy Little Bee
description:
Each shot to a different target will give 1 stack, up to 10, each stack will give 20% weapon damage increase.

Stacks will activate once the agent switches weapons and will last for 10 seconds.

name: Capitulate
description: Hitting an enemy applies -4% Movement Speed for each pellet hit for 5 seconds. Shooting the enemy again will reapply the stacks.

name: Cover Shooter
description:
Every bullet fired while in cover increases Weapon Damage by 1% up to 100%. The bonus lasts for 15s.

Getting a kill with this weapon while in cover resets the duration.

The bonus damage is cancelled by reloading, swapping weapons or exiting combat.The bonus damage is cancelled by reloading, swapping weapons or exiting combat.

name: Doctor Home
description:
Shooting an enemy with this weapon will apply a mark for 5 seconds. 

If a marked target is killed it will drop a 10% Armor repair kit which applies to the whole party when picked up. 

The Kit will not give bonus armor.

name: Ortiz Assault Interface
description:
While scoped, the weapon will highlight a random body section of each enemy.
The weapon deals +75% Weapon Damage to highlighted body sections.

name: Rule them all
description:
When the agent has a Status Effect applied to them, their next magazine will be 50% filled with that Status Effect.
 Only occurs during combat

name: Shakedown
description:
Body shots add 1 stack to the enemy for 10s. Max stacks: 300%. 
Hitting a different enemy removes all stacks.

This weapon deals +4% Amplified Damage per stack.

Your next headshot on an enemy with stacks consumes all stacks, dealing +11% Amplified Damage per stack.

Destroying an enemy's weakpoint causes them to take +10% Amplified Damage from you for 5s.

name: The Trap
description:
Tags enemies when in scope (maximum of 10) If Agent kills any marked target with a headshot, all other targets will have 50% (20% PVP) movement speed decreased and receive burn for 10 seconds.

Cooldown 30 seconds.

Killing another enemy with a headshot will shorten the cooldown for 10 seconds.

Targets are marked after 2 seconds in scope.

name: Unnerve
description:
Killing an enemy will apply a mark on every enemy within 20m of it. Multiple marks can be applied to the same enemy. Max number of marks that can be applied to an enemy is 5.
Deal +15% Amplified Damage per mark to marked enemies.

name: You can look...
description:
When out of combat, receive 10 stacks.
This weapon deals +12.5% Amplified Damage per stack.

name: Adaptive Instincts
description:
Hitting 30 headshots grant +20% critical hit chance and +50% critical hit damage for 45s.

Hitting 65 bodyshots grant +90% weapon damage for 45s.

Hitting 20 legshots grant +150% reload speed for 45s.

name: Big Game Hunter
description:
When scoped, switches to semi-automatic fire mode, dealing 450% weapon damage with each shot.

Headshots grant +6% headshot damage. Stacks up to 25 times. Once at full stacks, 10 stacks decay every 400% seconds until all stacks have been removed. Headshots delay decaying of stacks.

name: Caduceus
description: Critical hits repair you and your allies for 3% of the hit's dealt damage.

name: Capacitance
description: Shooting enemies builds stacks to a cap of 40. Each stack grants 1.5% Skill Damage. After 5 seconds, stacks decay 100% per second. For each skill tier gain 7.5% weapon damage.

name: Capacitance
description: Shooting enemies builds stacks to a cap of 40. Each stack grants 1.5% Skill Damage. After 5 seconds, stacks decay 100% per second. For each skill tier gain 7.5% weapon damage.

name: Eagle's Strike
description:
Accuracy increases as you continuously fire, up to +30%.

Headshot kills grant +0% Reload Speed, +0% Damage and the Tenacity buff for 15s.

The strength of Tenacity is increased by 1% for body shots and 5% for headshots.

name: Perturb
description:
While this weapon is holstered, generate 50% less Threat when shooting. Keeping this weapon holstered for 10s will prime it.

While primed, swapping to this weapon grants +25% Rate of Fire, +30% Weapon Damage and you generate 100% more Threat when shooting for 15s.

Swapping from this weapon before the timer ends removes the bonuses.

name: Protected Fire
description: While holstered, gain +10% bonus armor while firing your current weapon.

name: Tenacity
description:
40%-80% of damage taken is delayed until the buff expires.

All of the total delayed damage is reduced for each enemy killed while the buff is active, up to 100% with 300% kills.

name: Bullet Hell
description:
This weapon never needs to be reloaded.

For every 100 bullets that hit an enemy, replenish some ammo to you and your allies' reserves.

name: Disruptor Rounds
description:
Shooting an enemy marks that enemy and adds a stack to the the agent up to a count of 50. Shooting a marked enemy refreshes the mark and adds stacks to the agent.
When you deploy a non-shield skill, remove all stacks on agent and all marked targets trigger an effect.

1 - 10 Stacks - Pulse marked targets for 5 seconds
11 - 25 Stacks - Pulse and Disrupt marked targets for 5 seconds.
26 - 49 Stacks - Pulse, Disrupt, and Disorient marked targets for 5 seconds.
50 Stacks - Pulse, Disrupt, and Disorient marked targets and all hostiles within 10 meters of the marked targets for 5 seconds. This effect will trigger immediately if any marked enemy is killed.

name: Outcast Resilience
description: While holstered, gain 20% bonus armor for 5s whenever you are affected by blind, bleed, or burning.

name: Pakhan
description: Each kill with this weapon gains a stack of 75% Magazine Size increase to the next magazine, up to 400% stacks.

name: Pestilence
description:
This debuff reduces healing received by 50% for 10s.  

Whenever an enemy with Pestilence would be downed, they are instead instantly killed.

The debuff is removed if the enemy is repaired to full armor.

name: Plague of the Outcasts
description:
Hits apply a debuff dealing 100% weapon damage over 10s. This stacks up to 50 times. 

Whenever an enemy dies with this debuff, 100% of the stacks are transferred to a nearby enemy within 25m.

name: Electromagnetic Accelerator
description: Shots fired deal 0-100% weapon damage based on how long the trigger is held before releasing.

name: Full Stop
description:
Shooting enemies builds stacks to a cap of 20. 
Headshots grant 2 stacks. 
Each stack grants 2% Weapon Damage and 5% Headshot Damage. On reload, clear all stacks and gain 5% of your max armor as temp armor for 10 seconds for each stack removed.

Headshot kills with Dread Edict restore all bullets in the magazine. This does not count as a reload.

name: High Priority Target
description:
Amplifies Weapon Damage by 125% to the highest ranking enemies within the Tier hierarchy.

Tier 1: Hunter, Rogue, Leader, Tank, Shield, Heavy Weapons, RPG, Medic, Controller, Warhound, Marauder

Tier 2: Support, Engineer, Bodyguard, Immobilizer, Bomber, Mini Tank, Drone Operator

Tier 3: Any other enemy or skill proxy

name: In Plain Sight
description:
Your scoped view displays additional information about enemies not targeting you.

Headshot and weakpoint damage against enemies not targeting you amplified by 50%.

Headshot kills reset the cooldown of the Decoy skill.  This bonus will wait until the Decoy goes on cooldown if currently active.

name: Nemesis
description:
Aiming at an enemy marks them as your nemesis for 15s, letting you see them through walls.  

Your shots gain +5% damage to your nemesis for each second they are marked, to a max of 50%.

name: Preparation
description: While holstered, gain +15% headshot damage when scoped with your current weapon.

name: Blind Justice
description:
Damage done against enemy skill proxies is increased by 30%. Destroying a enemy skill proxy increases reload speed by 5%.

Destroying a weakpoint increaes the damage of the next shot from this weapon by 5%. If this shot kills a enemy your magazine is refilled and weapon damage is increased by 100% for the entire magazine, this damage stacks with all other damage increase buffs.

name: Faster Than Reloading
description:
Having this weapon holstered for 5s reloads and primes it.

While primed, swapping to this weapon reloads your Primary and Secondary weapons and grants +20% Rate of Fire and +50% Weapon Damage until its magazine is emptied.

Reloading or swapping from this weapon before its magazine is emptied will remove its stat bonuses.

name: Independence
description: While holstered, destroying weakpoints refills 20% of your current weapon's magazine.

name: Liberty or Death
description: After 30 hits, your shield is fully repaired.

name: Mosquito Song
description:
Hitting an enemy applies a stack. Stacks are shared between players.

At 5 stacks, the enemy will forcefully target the last player to apply a stack for 5s.

Stacks deplete every 5s. Activating the effect on an enemy will remove all stacks from other enemies.

name: Regicide
description: Headshot kills deals 400% weapon damage and applies bleed to enemies within 5m of the enemy killed.

name: Restrained
description: Deal 25% Amplified Damage for 20s after your Shield gets broken.

name: Agonizing Bite
description:
Diamondback randomly marks an enemy within 20m. If no enemies are within 20m, it marks the enemy closest to you.

Hitting that enemy consumes the mark, guaranteeing a critical hit with damage amplified by 20%. 

After hitting a mark, all shots fired are guaranteed critical hits for 5s.

A new random enemy is marked afterwards and whenever you reload.

name: Binary Trigger
description:
This weapon fires on trigger pull and release. 

If both bullets hit the same enemy, gain a stack.

At 7 stacks,  shooting an enemy creates a 7m explosion dealing 5% weapon damage, consuming the stacks.

name: Brutality
description: While holstered, landing a shot has a 5% chance to deal +100% damage as explosive damage.

name: Deep Fangs
description: After hitting 5 marked enemies, gain +50% reload speed, +20% total damage,  and all shots fired are guaranteed critical hits for 15s.

name: Geri and Freki
description:
On trigger-pull, fire both barrels at once.

When fired from the right  shoulder, hits add offensive primers, and defensive primers when fired from the left shoulder.

Hits from one shoulder will detonate all of the opposite shoulder's primers when present.

When detonated, each offensive primer deals 100% weapon damage+4% bonus armor for 5s.

Primer effectiveness is doubled at 10 stacks.

name: Guerilla Warfare
description:
This weapon fires on trigger pull and release. 

If both bullets hit the same enemy, gain a stack.

At 10 stacks,  shooting an enemy creates a 7m explosion dealing 20% weapon damage, consuming the stacks.

name: Shedding Skin
description:
While drawn, each time a round is loaded, gain +20% bonus armor for 300%s.  

While holstered, each time you reload or cycle your current weapon, gain +8% bonus armor for 200%s.

name: Transfusion
description:
Hitting headshots builds stacks, up to a max of 8. When shooting an Ally or Skill, repair them for 50% of the shot's damage for each stack.

Healed Allies will receive 50% of your Repair Skills bonus as Bonus Armor for each stack for 10s.

All hits are guaranteed headshots for 8s after healing an Ally or Skill while at maximum stacks.

name: Blabbermouth
description: While holstered, reloading your weapon within 5s after a kill grants 15% rate of fire for 10s.

name: Box Magazine
description:
Kills with this weapon refill 75% of its magazine and grants a buff for 10s.  

While the buff is active, every shot landed increases magazine capacity by 300% to a max of 60.  Killing a target consumes the buff to fully refill the increased magazine.

name: Breathe Free
description:
When moving, gain 400% stacks per second, or 8 stacks if sprinting, up to 75% stacks total.

Each round fired consumes a stack, amplifying damage by 20%.

Kills grant +10% movement speed for {5}s.

name: Chatterbox
description:
When you reload, rate of fire is increased by 25% for each enemy within 15m for the whole magazine.

Max Stacks: 5

name: Gangland Hit
description:
Shooting an enemy with this weapon applies a <mark. You can only apply one mark at a time. Shooting another enemy will transfer the mark.

More marks can be applied on the same enemy by other agents using this weapon. Maximum amount of marks that can be applied on an enemy is 20%.

This weapon deals +5% Amplified Damage to marked enemies. The bonus is increased by 400% for each extra mark on the enemy other than your own.

name: Payment in Kind
description:
Dealing damage to enemies adds a stack of +2% critical hit damage, up to to 100 stacks, lasting 10s.

On reload apply a 10s bleed to yourself, which deals 0.5% armor damage per stack.

name: Autentico
description:
+35% Weapon Damage
+100% Accuracy
No Damage Drop Off.

These bonuses are built into the weapon's base stats.

name: Evasive
description: Dodging refills a portion of your equipped weapon's magazine.

name: Sandman
description:
Melee attacks instantly kill non-elite enemies.

Cooldown: 15s.

name: Sandman
description:
Melee attacks instantly kill non-elite enemies.

Cooldown: 15s.

name: Sandman
description: This debuff prevents the enemy from using armor kits and from receiving healing from any source.

name: Septic Shock
description:
Shooting a target applies stacks of venom, which last for 10s. Increasing stacks adds more severe debuffs to the target.
 
200% - Poison
400% - Disorient
6 - Shock
9 - Target takes additional 20% damage (from all sources). Stacks no longer increase.

Duration of Status Effects is based on percentage of pellets hit on applying shot.

name: Adrenaline Rush
description:
Whenever you are within 10m of an enemy, gain 20% bonus armor for 5s.  Stacks up to 300% times. 

Cooldown: 5s

name: Aegis
description: When within 10m of a hostile all incoming damage is reduced by 30% and 10% for all allies.

name: Calculated
description: Kills while in cover reduce active Skill Cooldowns.

name: Clutch
description: If you are below 15%  armor, Critical hits repair 2.5% missing armor.

name: Companion
description: While you are within 5m of an ally or skill, total weapon damage is increased by 15%.

name: Composure
description: While in cover, increases total weapon damage by 15%.

name: Concussion
description:
Headshots increase total weapon damage by 10% for 150%s. 5s with marksman rifles.

Headshot kills increase total weapon damage by 15% for 10s.

name: Creeping Death
description:
When you apply a status effect, it is also applied to all enemies within 8m of your target.  

Cooldown: 15s

name: Energize
description:
Using an armor kit grants +1 skill tier for 15s. If already at skill tier 6, grants overcharge.

Cooldown: 60s

name: Fireworks Show
description:
Concussion Grenades become Festive Grenades.

Hitting an enemy with a Festive Grenade will cause explosions to happen around two other enemies within 20m.

name: Galvanize
description: Applying a blind, ensnare, confuse, or shock to an enemy grants 40% of your armor as bonus armor to allies within 20m of that enemy for 10s.

name: Guardian
description: While at full armor, increases total skill repair by 130%.

name: Hoarder
description:
+300% Grenade Capacity
+50% Grenade Radius
+35% Grenade Damage
+25% Grenade Damage for each extra enemy caught in the blast

name: Lazarus
description: After reviving a teammate all party members within 10m have healing effects applied to them increased by 100% for 15 seconds.

name: Leadership
description:
Performing a cover to cover grants 15% of your armor as bonus armor to you and all allies for 10s.  

This is doubled if you end within 10m of an enemy.

Cooldown: 10s

name: On the Ropes
description: Weapon Damage is increased while all Skills are on cooldown.

name: Opportunistic
description: Enemies you hit with shotguns and marksman rifles amplifies the damage they take by 10% from all sources for 5s.

name: Overclock
description: Allies within 7m of your deployed skills, gain +25% reload speed and reduces their active cooldowns by 20%s each second.

name: Patched
description: Using an Armor Kit repairs nearby group members Armor by the amount of Armor repaired.

name: Perfect Adrenaline Rush
description:
Whenever you are within 10m of an enemy, gain 23% bonus armor for 5s.  Stacks up to 300% times. 

Cooldown: 5s

name: Perfect Clutch
description: Critical hits repair 20% missing armor while below 2.5% armor.

name: Perfect Companion
description: While you are within 10m of an ally or skill, total weapon damage is increased by 20%

name: Perfect Composure
description: While in cover, increases total weapon damage by 20%.

name: Perfect Concussion
description: Headshots grant +20% headshot damage for 200%s. 5s with marksman rifles.

name: Perfect Galvanize
description: Applying a Blind, Ensnare, Confuse, or Shock to an enemy grants 50% of your armor as bonus armor to you and all allies within 30m of that enemy for 10s.

name: Perfect Leadership
description:
Performing a cover to cover grants 20% of your armor as bonus armor to you and all allies for 10s.  

This is tripled if you end within 10m of an enemy.

Cooldown: 10s

name: Perfect Safeguard
description: While at full armor, increases total skill repair by 160%.

name: Perfect Shock and Awe
description: Applying a status effect to an enemy increases total skill damage and repair by 20% for 27s.

name: Perfect Tech Support
description: Skill kills increase total skill damage by 25% for 27s.

name: Perfectly Calculated
description: Kills from cover reduce skill cooldowns by 15%.

name: Perfectly On the Ropes
description: Weapon damage is increased by +20% while all skills are on cooldown.

name: Perfectly Opportunistic
description: Enemies you hit take 15% more damage from all sources for 5s.

name: Perfectly Wicked
description: Applying a status effect increases total weapon damage by 18% for 27s.

name: Protector
description:
When your shield is damaged, you gain +5% bonus armor and all other allies gain 15% of your armor as bonus armor for 300%s. 

Cooldown: 300%s

name: Second Primary Weapon
description: You can now equip a second primary weapon.

name: Selfless
description: Using a Armor Kit while at full armor applies a overshield.

name: Shock and Awe
description: Applying a status effect to an enemy increases total skill damage and repair by 20% for 20s.

name: Tech Support
description: Skill kills increase total skill damage by 25% for 25%s.

name: Wicked
description: Applying a status effect increases total weapon damage by 18% for 20s.

name: Combined Arms
description: Shooting an enemy increases total skill damage by 25% for 300%s.

name: Perfect Combined Arms
description: Shooting an enemy increases total skill damage by 30% for 300%s.

name: Perfect Versatile
description:
Amplifies total weapon damage for 10s when swapping between your primary and secondary weapons if they are different.
